focus: Existing M03 manual-room ideal rectangular emitting-face corner geometry against walls, floor and optional ceiling; translated/noncentral fixtures; finite/degenerate aims and unavailable status; source-center versus whole-face semantics.

checks.result: Four corners use +/- half width and height along shared frame.right/frame.up, then the same room transformation as centers. Signed left/right/near/far distances use coordinate extrema; negative minimum distances are violations. Checking all four corners is sufficient for the convex rectangle and its projection.

World corners are formed around the actual light.position, then floor mapping subtracts scene.subject x/z before room offsets and yaw. Existing testWorldTranslationPreservesProjectedCorners translates source, subject, camera and manual aim by (+8, -6) horizontally at yaw 37 and compares projected corners and crossed walls; center-inside/face-crossing cases use noncentral sources.

checks.case: Source center versus full ideal face
checks.result: points/outsideCount remain distinct from modifierFootprints/crossingModifierCount; testCenterInsideDoesNotHideCrossingModifier and default portrait fixture explicitly assert inside centers with a crossing face. Vertical center and face clearances are also stored separately.

Corner heights determine face minima/maxima. Negative floor or ceiling clearance reports violation, including a face wholly outside the permitted half-space. Unmeasured ceiling preserves nil full-height containment when no floor violation exists; a known floor violation remains false. Unavailable geometry preserves nil heights even if ceiling measurement exists.

Plan validates scene first. Positions and manual aims require finite coordinates in -100...100; dimensions and roll are bounded and finite. UnitDirection rejects zero/nonfinite direction and normalizes using maximum-component scaling. Coincident valid source/target returns no frame and an empty unavailable footprint with nil clearance. Invalid nonfinite input is rejected rather than yielding a clear face.

Degenerate-aim test requires false isAvailable, nil isInsideRoom and clearance, unavailable count 1 and crossing count 0. Nonrectangular emitters produce no claimed footprint. Source scene equality checks protect value semantics.

conclusion: No concrete defect found within the assigned scope at the pinned revision. Static review supports the current ideal-emitter-face geometry and availability semantics; this does not establish executed test acceptance.
